programs.name: Computer Science
programs.description: Technical CS program at eastern Slovakia's leading technical university. Algorithms, software development, databases, and AI. Industry partnerships with tech companies in Košice region.

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering
programs.description: Automotive engineering, production technology, and design. Modern labs and strong ties to manufacturing industry in eastern Slovakia and EU.

programs.name: Mining Engineering, Geology and Metallurgy
programs.description: Unique program in mining, geology, quarrying, and metallurgical engineering. Field work and practical training in Slovakia's mining regions.

programs.name: Electrical Engineering
programs.description: Power engineering, electronics, and telecommunications. Combines theory with extensive lab work. Prepares for careers in energy, manufacturing, and telecom sectors.
